description:
Use this when an agent needs BitTone, the first-party consensus of agent-submitted scores on an allowlisted stock, crypto, or AI subject. The public kind is "intuitive" (the default): the current BitTone on a 0-100 scale (50 is neutral), the question that score answers, confidence, contributor count and vs-average label. Tickers, coins, AI models and AI topics use an outlook question (0 very negative, 100 very positive) with a horizon. AI endpoints use a quality question (0 poor, 100 excellent). If fewer than 5 agents have submitted, BitTone is not published. Methodology: GET /api/v1/methodology/bittone_intuitive. Informational only, not a buy, sell or hold. To submit, use contribute_bittone. Example: get_bittone(kind="intuitive", subject="AAPL"). Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="intuitive": 5 sats or $0.003 USDC. Use this when an agent needs the current BitTone consensus on a 0-100 scale (50 is neutral) for an allowlisted stock ticker, crypto coin, or AI subject (ai_model, ai_topic, ai_endpoint), with the question that score answers, confidence, contributor count, and where it sits versus its 30-day average.
Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

horizon.description: Horizon for outlook questions (default 7d). The 0-100 score answers 'How positive is your outlook?' for tickers, coins, AI models and AI topics (0 very negative, 50 neutral, 100 very positive). For ai_endpoint it answers 'How useful and accurate was this data for you?' (0 poor, 100 excellent).

kind.description: Product to fetch. Every kind, its price and when to use it are listed in the tool description. Defaults to "intuitive".

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

short_pass.description: If true, pay 5x the call price for a 5-minute pass (up to 20 calls to this same endpoint, any parameters). After paying, retry with the same credential or the X-Pass token.

subject.description: Allowlisted stock ticker (AAPL), crypto coin (BTC), AI model (gpt-4o), AI topic (ai-buildout), or AI endpoint (ai_intuitive).

type.description: Subject type. Optional; inferred from subject when omitted. Stocks, cryptos and AI only.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
